tasks.label: Backend: run server
tasks.command: uv run --project server python server/manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000

tasks.label: Backend: test
tasks.command: env -u DATABASE_URL DJANGO_ENVIRONMENT=test uv run --project server pytest server/tests

tasks.label: Backend: type check
tasks.command: env -u DATABASE_URL DJANGO_ENVIRONMENT=test uv run --project server mypy --config-file server/pyproject.toml server

tasks.label: Backend: Django check
tasks.command: uv run --project server python server/manage.py check
